description: Say whether FinancialMD serves a dataset, and if not, why and what to use instead. Call it before searching for data that may not be here: Street consensus estimates, consensus EPS and revenue estimates, analyst ratings, price targets, earnings call transcripts and audio, real-time, intraday or consolidated prices, CUSIP or ISIN, Morningstar research, wire news and mutual fund NAV are not served (licensed, not built, or waiting on a decision). For forward numbers FinancialMD serves its own model-based estimates and company guidance (company_estimates), which are not consensus. With no topic it lists every dataset with its routes and tools.

topic.description: What you are looking for, in a few words (for example "consensus estimates", "transcripts", "intraday prices", "segments").

name: coverage

outputSchema.description: The FinancialMD envelope (docs/API.md section 2): data plus meta (request_id, as_of knowledge time, matched company, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base). Every numeric value inside data is an object with value, unit, currency, period, known interval, restated flag, method and a proof pointing at the filing. On failure the result is isError with an error object instead.

data.description: { datasets: [{ id, name, status, routes, mcp_tools, reason, licence, alternatives }], note, free_coverage?: { as_of, companies: [{ cik, ticker, name }], funds: [{ cik, name }] } }

error.description: Present only on isError results: the API error code and message plus remedy hints.

meta.description: Request metadata: request_id, as_of, company resolution, coverage, pipeline_version, licence, terms, proof_base.

attribution.description: Citations a source requires on anything shown from the answer.

title: What FinancialMD covers (and does not)
